parsed.why: State executive order applies birth-sex rules to state-owned bathrooms and shelters; K-12 facility ban, marker bans, public-funding care ban reaching adults, no state gender-identity protections. Hostile layer above the restrictive national framework.

Broad criminal-trespass facility statute covers airports, government buildings, parks and schools; documented arrest and travel advisory. This traveller-facing exclusion plus national entry/custody regime puts it at the Do Not Travel boundary.

Low-risk tier with operative gender-identity discrimination protections, X markers, birth-certificate change, sanctuary-city care shield; no adult facility or care ban. Still constrained by the harsh national border, document and custody framework.

Low-risk tier, largely refrains from targeting trans adults; bathroom and pronoun bills vetoed. But youth care/sports bans, no gender-identity hate-crime coverage, panic defence, and Pride collapse signal weaker protection than dossier 3.

Worst-risk tier; gender-identity civil-rights protection repealed and local protections preempted, binary sex definition, school bathroom rule binding all on school grounds. No documented general adult public-restroom statute, but remedy absent.
